== Biography ==
Washington Barry Jeans "Jenas" Glasgow was born 21 Feb 1845 in Tennessee. He was the son of Elijah Hawking Glasgow and Jane Caroline Jeans.<ref>'''Birth''' Census Year: 1850; Census Place: District 11, Henry, Tennessee; Roll: M432_884; Page: 338B; Image: 194 APID:  1,8054::6249221</ref>

==Military==
Jeans served with the Confederate States Army

== Marriage ==
Jeans married Angeline Smart (1846–1932) circa 1879<ref>'''Marriage'''Census Year: 1900; Census Place: Blue Cane, Clay, Arkansas; Roll: 53; Page: 28B; Enumeration District: 0001; FHL microfilm: 1240053 APID:  1,7602::35223247</ref>

==Death==
Jeans died 26 Mar 1907 (aged 62) <ref>'''Death''' FindAGrave [https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/154993076/washington-barry_jeans-glasgow]</ref>
